title: news home save
description: Store a draft curation (home-draft.v1, ../home-draft.v1.schema.json) from a file, or - for stdin. Only the shape is refused here; slot counts, ID formats and the breadth rules are `news home check`'s. The same open draft saved again returns its id. Input is the command's arguments as an object; output is the envelope's data.

created.description: False when an identical open draft already existed.
